India's KAL Drone Targets Global Markets for Export

India is pushing for export of its indigenous KAL long-range attack drone, with IG Defence eyeing Gulf and global markets. The drone has a range of 1,000 km. This export push is drawing international interest, with other countries reportedly looking to purchase the drone.
